# DualShock Podcast — Blady’s retrospective

- Original source: [Robin Hood – Legenda Sherwood](https://dspodcast.pl/artykuly/robin-hood-legenda-sherwood/)
- Author / publication: Blady; DualShock Podcast.
- Language / date: Polish; 2010-06-30.
- Access: Article body inspected.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

Blady describes returning to older tactical games on a laptop and praises the freedom to build a preferred team and combine its abilities. The retrospective discusses camp work, reconnaissance, forest traps, and coordinated infiltration. Its strongest enthusiasm is for interactions between complementary characters, especially distractions that let another hero incapacitate guards.

Criticisms include repeated maps, lengthy missions, difficult late battles, and ordinary recruits becoming less useful once the named heroes are available. The author also dislikes the scarcity of cinematic interludes and compulsory duels. Specific ability descriptions are the writer’s account, not a verified reference; the suggested production-budget explanation is speculation.
